# Sifat Bhatia — Design Engineer & Creative Technologist

## About

Sifat Bhatia is a design engineer and creative technologist based in Los Angeles, California. He builds websites, brand identities, and digital experiences for artists, agencies, and creative brands who need more than templates.

He holds a BS from Full Sail University (Valedictorian) and is currently completing an MS in Information Technology at Westcliff University. He is the founder of Siftion, an independent design and development studio.

## Expertise

- **Frontend Development:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion
- **Design:** UI/UX, visual identity, design systems, typography, motion design
- **No-Code/Low-Code:** Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace
- **Branding:** Logo design, color systems, brand strategy
- **Tools:** Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Git, Vercel

## Work Authorization

F-1 student on CPT (Curricular Practical Training). Authorized for part-time and full-time employment.

## Notable Projects

### J. Worra
Artist website and web identity for a DJ/producer. Dark, motion-driven design that translates the energy of electronic music into scroll-driven experiences. Built with React, GSAP, and Lenis. Result: 3x increase in average session duration.

### L'Affaire Musicale
Full rebrand and website rebuild for a music agency. Editorial layout, CMS-backed roster management, typography-first approach. Built with Next.js, Sanity CMS, and Framer Motion.

### ClipKeep
A local-first clip vault for saving and organizing TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube links. Includes collections, favorites, metadata previews, search, optional encrypted Supabase snapshot sync, and experimental NVIDIA AI summaries. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, localStorage, and resilient social URL parsing.

### QLO Agency
Custom Webflow builds with advanced interactions, CMS collections, and client-friendly editing. Modular component systems.
